name: Agent Chat
summary: One chat window for the whole film: the agent messages first and the anomaly arrives as a tool card with a Roll back chip.
look: Warm paper, one white chat window with ink user bubbles and white agent bubbles, a teal Acme-mark avatar, a coral-headed tool card and serif film titles above the thread.

components.name: User bubble
components.role: right-aligned, ink fill, white text, sharp bottom-right corner

components.name: Agent bubble
components.role: left, white card with hairline + Acme mark avatar and a mono “ACME PULSE” label

components.name: Typing indicator
components.role: three dots pulsing on the beat; in the hook it dies unanswered

components.name: Tool card
components.role: coral header strip, giant mono number, sparkline with deploy rule, context line, action chips

components.name: System note
components.role: centred mono line (“you didn’t ask · Pulse started this”) that gives time and agency

components.name: Composer
components.role: pill input with teal send button; the CTA is styled as the final outgoing message

motion.name: Bubble pop
motion.how: scale .9 → 1 + 30 px rise from its sender side, back.out(1.6) 0.3 s, one per beat (0.5 s at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Thread scroll
motion.how: older bubbles translate up by bubble height, power2.out 0.25 s, synced to each new pop

motion.name: Tool-card unfold
motion.how: height 0 → auto via clip-path over 0.5 s (power3.out) landing on a bar downbeat; chips stagger in 0.1 s apart

story: Hook: a team group chat fills with unanswered questions about 38 dashboards. Reveal: the thread clears on the drop and Acme Pulse comes online with rings and a first message. Proof: Pulse writes first — a tool card shows Checkout conversion −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231 — and the user replies “Roll back.” CTA: the chat folds into the lockup and Start free pops up as the last bubble.
adapt: Replace the tool card with the richest result your product returns (a diff, a chart, a booking, a draft) and keep the pattern: the agent speaks first, the human answers with one decisive action.

references.note: tool results rendered as components inside chat
generative UI announcement with streaming components

fit.risk: Easily reads as a generic chatbot demo; keep the tool card and human decision as the hero.
